integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A photoreal cinematic drone shot in warm late afternoon sunlight, soft long shadows, rich natural colour and crisp detail, filmed on a wide lens. The camera flies a slow, smooth, steady arc to the right around an old stone cottage in an English country garden, keeping the cottage in the centre of the frame and staying at the height of its eaves, so the front, the corner and then the side of the cottage turn toward the camera one after another. The cottage has thick walls of rough honey-coloured stone, a deep roof of grey slate tiles patched with green moss, a dark green wooden door, small white-framed windows with flower boxes of red geraniums and a short stone chimney. In front of it a gravel path runs between beds of lavender, white daisies and tall pink foxgloves. To the left an old wooden hand cart loaded with three wooden barrels stands on the grass, and a weathered oak bench sits under a low apple tree heavy with green apples. A golden retriever lies perfectly still on the grass beside the path, head resting on its paws. A dry stone wall runs along the back of the garden, and beyond it rolling green fields, a line of tall oak trees and a few soft white clouds in a pale blue sky. Everything in the garden stays still apart from a faint stir of leaves.
overall_soundscape: Birdsong, a light breeze in the leaves and distant sheep.
non_diegetic_music: none

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A photoreal cinematic shot in soft golden morning light, gentle haze, rich detail and natural colour, filmed on a wide lens. The camera moves in a slow, smooth, steady arc to the left around the centre of an ancient ruined temple courtyard, at head height, keeping a broken marble statue in the middle of the frame, so the columns on either side slide past one another and the courtyard reveals its depth. The courtyard floor is made of large worn sandstone slabs with grass and small white flowers growing in the cracks. In the middle stands a weathered marble statue of a robed figure on a square stone plinth, its arms broken off at the elbows, its surface pale and matte with soft grey stains. Around it rise thick fluted sandstone columns of different heights, some whole and topped by a fragment of carved beam, others broken off halfway, their bases wrapped in ivy and ferns. Low stone steps lead up to a doorway in a crumbling back wall, and tall dark cypress trees and green hills stand beyond. A young woman in a long red wool coat and dark boots stands perfectly still on the slabs to the right of the statue, looking up at it, her hands in her pockets, the whole of her figure and her feet well clear of the bottom of the frame.
overall_soundscape: A soft breeze, distant birds and the quiet of an empty ruin.
non_diegetic_music: none

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] A photoreal cinematic drone shot in warm low afternoon sunlight, long soft shadows, rich earthy colour and crisp detail, filmed on a wide lens. The camera flies a slow, smooth, steady arc to the right around a small desert campsite on flat red sand, at about twice head height, keeping the campsite in the centre of the frame so its parts turn and reveal their sides. A vintage olive green off-road vehicle with a canvas roof, a spare wheel on the back and dusty tyres is parked beside a beige canvas bell tent with its door flap tied open. In front of the tent a ring of dark stones holds a cold campfire of grey ash, with two folding wooden chairs, a low wooden crate used as a table and a dented enamel kettle on it. A coiled rope, a jerrycan and a stack of firewood sit by the vehicle. Large rounded red sandstone boulders lie scattered across the sand, and behind the camp tall layered canyon walls of orange and red rock rise toward a clear deep blue sky. Nothing moves except a faint shimmer of heat.
overall_soundscape: A dry desert wind, the tick of cooling metal and a distant hawk.
non_diegetic_music: none
